note: AgentCore Gateway tool schemas (MCP). Source of truth for infra/deploy.py. Targets: sg-store (Lambda agent/tools_lambda/store.py), sg-cool (Lambda agent/tools_lambda/cool.py -> Graviton COOL box /v1/review). Tool I/O carries ids, hashes, scores and severity tiers only, never pixels, titles or URLs.

sg-store.name: policy_get
sg-store.description: Read this device's policy for one app (bundle id or bare domain): min_mode, escalation_rate_per_s, prefrost, and the counts of COOL reviews confirmed / cleared.

sg-store.name: policy_put
sg-store.description: Set this device's policy for one app. min_mode is medium or aggressive (never off, never below the parent's PIN mode). escalation_rate_per_s 0.5..6. prefrost: cover new pictures until checked.

sg-store.name: verdict_put
sg-store.description: Store the final verdict for one escalated picture (by dHash): CONFIRM (keep covered), CLEAR (uncover), or KEEP_UNSURE.

sg-store.name: audit_append
sg-store.description: Append one short neutral audit line for the parent. Never describe picture content.

sg-cool.name: cool_second_look
sg-cool.description: Deep multi-scale OpenCV review (NudeNet 320n on COOL OpenCV, AWS Graviton) of the escalated picture the box holds in RAM. Returns found, verdict.state (SAFE | UNSURE | UNSAFE), score, severity tiers.
